[[/hcell]] [[hcell colspan="3"]] Synchro [[/hcell]] [[/row]] [[row]] [[cell colspan="3"]] The pet for taking down bosses quickly. Has the highest DPS among all pets, but is hardest to use, and get stunned quickly. Synchro's setup requires you to have superfluous amount of PP (above 150, 185 would be ideal), them to be summoned after a stunned pet (best using Melon); after that, you need to learn to use different PA in order to power up Synchro Geki. Synchro is the best pet to use with Bouncer sub and good to take down Magatsu and Luther. [[/cell]] [[/row]]

Personality Description
[[image http:capa.wdfiles.com/local--files/guide:phantasy-star-online-2-summoner/Personality.png class="pet-personality"]]Thoughtful (なかま思い Devoted//) 112% damage if Synchro is summoned after a stunned pet. This is the preferred personality due to its huge boost. The boost stays during area change; it will be reset if Synchro is switched out or entering campship.
[[image http:capa.wdfiles.com/local--files/guide:phantasy-star-online-2-summoner/Personality.png class="pet-personality"]]Sly (こうかつ Cunning//) PP Cost reduced by 20% if summoned after a stunned pet.
[[image http://capa.wdfiles.com/local--files/guide:phantasy-star-online-2-summoner/Personality.png class="pet-personality"]]Gentle (ジェントル) ★14 only. Combines Thoughtful and Sly, as well as having increased rare item drop rate.

[[table class="wiki-content-table border-top-none border-bottom-none"]] [[row]] [[hcell class="border-top-none"]] Strength [[/hcell]] [[hcell class="border-top-none"]] Weakness [[/hcell]] [[/row]] [[row]] [[cell class="pros-cons-list pros w-50 border-bottom-none"]]

  • Premier boss killer
  • Has the most powerful DPS attack
  • High-powered normal attacks
  • High Pwr
  • Quickest recall attack
  • Has an attack with guard frames
  • Has an attack that Binds
  • High-powered normal attacks

[[/cell]] [[cell class="pros-cons-list cons w-50 border-bottom-none"]]

  • Unsuitable for newbies
  • Low HP
  • Low DEF
  • Requires chaining different PAs to maximize damage
  • Requires to be summoned after stunned pet to maximize damage
  • Low PP regain from normal attacks
  • Recovers long from stun

[[/cell]] [[/row]] [[/table]]

1 DPS: Damage Per Second, the higher the better.
2 Normal Attack DPS Rating: The DPS rating of Normal Attacks. Hold is the DPS if you hold the normal attack button. Auto is the number if you let the pet attack freely. If only Hold exists, then the pet will do less if you don't hold the button. The number in bracket is the restored PP per second, disregarding natural PP regen.
3 Overall DPS Rating: The greater the number, the greater the pet's DPS potential is. This is calculated by using Glance of Darkness with Rykros Staff +30, during standard case scenario: Phantom sub, enemy is weak to pet's element, enemy isn't moving, a pair of 110% damage parfaits, using PA to deplete 200PP, then use Normal Attacks to get back 200PP (boosted natural PP regen and attack PP regen due to Phantom sub is calculated).
4 Sweets in bold are currently what Manaka put on her pets. For more information about Sweets, see the [#recommended-candies Recommended Sweets] Section.

[[/hcell]] [[hcell]] Kick (Kyaku) [[/hcell]] [[/row]] [[row]] [[cell class="pet-pa-remark border-bottom-none"]]

  • A spinning kick that lasts for 3 rotation, but only hit once.
  • The main use is to stall Chain state in case you need to do something else like Shifta, Deband, Resta, Fields etc.
  • Synchro will also have a Just Guard in all directions, but it does not work 100% of time so use it with care.
  • Chained Kyaku enlarges the area of effect.

5 GoD: Total DPS when using Glance of Darkness, the potential of Rykros Staff at +30 grind or more. Only applies to a single target.
6 GoD Plus: Total DPS when using Glance of Darkness Plus, the Ultimate Booster potential of Rykros Staff at +30 grind or more. Only applies to a single target.
7 Higher efficiency means lower PP consumption. An efficiency of 100 means you can sustain the attack for a long time. Remember that the most efficient attack doesn't mean that it will do decent DPS.
